graphEvents.label: The advisor default suite is serial by config

label: The repository configures nine vitest entry points for one surface, two of which exist only to hold env-gated stress suites.
The advisor default suite runs all 185 files with fileParallelism false, so its quoted 2.7 minutes is a serial floor rather than a property of the tests.
The deep-loop config keeps a hand-maintained five-pattern SERIAL_FILES list and splits the tree into parallel and serial projects by it, with no test that the list is complete.

Fifteen harness and helper files back the suites and the advisor and deep-loop configs resolve the spec-kit vitest-setup by relative path, which is why both workflows retrigger on spec-kit tests/_support changes.
Runtime fixture trees carry closed-packet numbering in their library paths, the same ephemeral-label pattern the comment-hygiene rule blocks in code.
No config records its own duration, so the parallel-versus-serial decision cannot be priced from the repository; only the workflow means and the quoted local 2.7 minutes exist.

direction: Deleting the two stress configs without relocating their suites
reason: The suites catch real behaviour; the config is the workaround for the env gate, not the problem itself.
